zh.summary: 从自然语言生成带后端与收费能力的原生移动应用。
zh.judgment: 可运行原型是入口，维护、分发和生产质量决定能否替代真实开发工作。
zh.replaces: 用户先做界面稿，再请开发者编写移动端、接认证和数据库并安排发布。
zh.product: 官网描述生成原生应用，定价页列出后端、认证、存储及支付集成，企业页侧重 iOS 与团队流程。不同平台的支持范围需核对，本次没有生成或发布应用。
zh.customer: 独立创作者、已有产品团队与企业内部应用团队是明确对象。商业需求在交付可维护功能，而不仅是一次漂亮演示。
zh.workflow: 用户描述目标后得到应用，再迭代界面和业务逻辑、连接数据及部署。应检验设备权限、支付、升级和代码接管，避免把能在手机预览当成完成上架。
zh.business_model: 价目按月提供免费额度及 Professional 25 欧元起等等级，核心计量是 AI token；另有一次性加购，优惠首月与常规月价分开列示。生成反复失败也会消耗额度，需算成功交付的成本。
zh.traction: 官网有开发者与企业用户评价，属于公司发布，未核验独立交付质量。评价中的原型节省时间不等于后续维护和商店审核已经完成。
zh.moat: 原生移动运行、后端连接与发布路径可能是相对通用生成器的优势。低代码工具、开发团队及其他 AI 构建器都是替代，迁移与接管难度影响粘性。
zh.funding_read: 融资可以推进地区与产品覆盖，下一里程碑应是持续运行的已发布应用。创建次数与收入应用数量需分别观察。
zh.risks: 生成代码错误可能在真实设备中暴露，支付与数据安全增加验收负担。token 消耗和平台限制也可能让复杂需求的总成本难预测。
zh.takeaway: 让生成器补齐应用交付链，公开说明预览、测试与发布的差别。以可接管的后端和代码降低用户继续维护的风险。
zh.watch_next: 看原型到正式发布的比例、返工 token、上线后故障和开发者接管时间。按简单工具与复杂业务应用分别统计。

en.summary: Natural-language creation of native mobile apps with backend and payment integrations.
en.judgment: Prototypes attract users; maintenance, distribution and production quality determine replacement of real development.
en.replaces: Designing screens, hiring mobile developers and separately connecting authentication, data and release workflows.
en.product: The site describes native apps; pricing lists backend, authentication, storage and payments. Enterprise material emphasizes iOS and team workflows. Platform scope requires confirmation; no app was built or released.
en.customer: Independent creators, product teams and internal enterprise builders are identifiable segments. Their commercial need is maintainable functionality rather than a single demonstration.
en.workflow: Describe an app, iterate interface and logic, connect data and deploy. Device permissions, payments, upgrades and code takeover need testing; phone previews do not establish store approval.
en.business_model: The page offers free allowances and Professional from €25/month, metered through AI tokens, with top-ups and separately labeled introductory discounts. Failed iterations also affect delivered-app cost.
en.traction: Official testimonials discuss prototypes and developer experience, without independently verified release quality. Claimed time savings do not establish ongoing maintenance or store acceptance.
en.moat: Native runtime and joined backend/release paths could differentiate it. Low-code tools, developers and AI builders remain alternatives; portability and takeover effort affect continuity.
en.funding_read: Capital supports coverage and expansion. Persistently running published apps are a better milestone than creation counts; revenue-generating apps require separate evidence.
en.risks: Generated errors may appear on actual devices, with payment and data security adding review. Token consumption and platform constraints can make complex builds unpredictable.
en.takeaway: Complete the application delivery chain and explain preview, testing and release separately. Transferable code and backend reduce maintenance risk.
en.watch_next: Watch prototype-to-release conversion, rework tokens, post-release failures and developer takeover time, separating simple tools from complex business apps.
